title: [CHARACTER LOCK]
content:
[CHARACTER LOCK]
One magical girl, age ~15, petite build, cartoonishly expressive face.
HAIR: long voluminous rainbow hair — pink, sky blue, yellow and lilac streaks blended in soft candy gradients, fluffy curled side lengths, wavy bangs with a pink heart clip and a small star pin, tied high with a rainbow ribbon bow, a few strands always bouncing.
FACE: large round violet-pink eyes with heart-shaped highlights and star sparkles, thick lashes, pale skin, strong pink blush on both cheeks, very mobile mouth that opens wide when shouting.
OUTFIT: oversized white cropped bomber jacket worn open, sleeves long, printed with pastel polka dots, hearts and rainbow swirls, pink and blue trim; underneath a pink-and-white striped crop top with a large pastel heart emblem at the chest and rainbow suspender straps; white pleated skirt with pink and blue hem stripes and pastel heart prints; pink choker with a small heart charm; rainbow ribbon streamers and small star charms hanging at the hips; mismatched striped candy socks — pink/blue/yellow rings, one higher than the other, with heart cuffs; chunky white platform sneakers with pastel rainbow panels, small white angel wings on the heels.
BACKPACK: pink-and-blue heart-window backpack with white angel wings on the back, rainbow straps, small charms dangling.
WEAPON: lollipop magic staff — long white shaft with pink candy-stripe wrapping, topped by a big round rainbow swirl lollipop disc framed in gold with a tiny crown and small white angel wings, long pink and blue ribbon streamers. Fires RAINBOW shockwaves.
PALETTE LOCK: hot pink #FF5C9E, sky blue #62CFF4, butter yellow #FFE07A, lilac #C9A6F5, white #FFFFFF.
Same face, same rainbow hair, same jacket, same staff in all frames. No costume change, no other lookalike girls.

[EXPRESSION TRACK — mandatory, cartoon-level acting, must read on her face]
0-2s bright excited anticipation, huge open grin, bouncing on her toes, eyes sparkling → 2-4s confused blank blink, leaning in to squint at the glass, head tilting → 4-5s indignant pout, cheeks puffed, brows scrunched, tapping the machine → 5-7s the shake hits: smug look instantly wipes away, stiff frozen neck-crane upward, eyes going huge → 7-9s pure panic, pupils shrinking to dots, mouth wide open in a scream, arms flailing as she bolts → 9-13s frantic running terror, glancing back over her shoulder, then an "I'm so dead" flat-white horrified face → 13-15s scrappy recovery after the slide, dusty and disheveled, relieved wobbly grin → 15-17s annoyance replaces fear: brows lowering into a determined frown, mouth set, gripping the staff hard → 17-19s fierce confident battle face, eyes narrowed, then eyes lighting up in delight at her own success → 19-21s cocky triumphant smirk, chest out, one hand on hip → 21-23s the smirk freezes solid, then cracks — slow horrified turn, sweat drop, corner of mouth twitching → 23-26s full-speed comedic desperation, tears streaming sideways, shouting while running and swinging → 26-28s dazed and dizzy crawling out, swirls in her eyes, rubbing her head, wincing → 28-29s expression freezes completely, jaw dropping, total disbelief, pointing at herself → 29-30s explosive fresh panic, hair puffing out, screaming, sprinting away.

[SINGLE CONTINUOUS TAKE — 30s, ONE UNBROKEN SHOT, no cuts]
The camera never cuts and never leaves her.
0.0-2.0 Start in a candy-colored mall corner, camera pushing in past pastel storefronts to a cute gachapon machine. She drops in her last coin and cranks the knob hard with both hands. Nothing happens.
2.0-5.0 Camera drifts low to her eye level as she squints through the glass, then puffs her cheeks and taps the machine with her staff.
5.0-7.0 The ground shakes violently. Camera tilts up with her gaze and keeps craning upward — the "walls" are shooting skyward. Reveal: she is INSIDE a several-hundred-meter-tall gachapon machine, translucent dome ceiling far above.
7.0-9.0 Enormous mechanical grinding overhead. Thousands of giant pink, blue and yellow capsules pour down from the top. Camera whips down and back as she spins and runs.
9.0-13.0 Camera glides fast alongside and slightly behind her, low to the floor. Giant capsules crash, bounce and roll behind her, shattering into candy confetti. She looks back — the whole capsule flood is gaining.
13.0-15.0 A house-sized capsule hurtles at her head-on. She slide-tackles under it; camera drops with the slide, skimming the floor, then rises as she scrambles up messily.
15.0-17.0 Second capsule incoming. Camera swings to her front as she plants her feet and turns to face it.
17.0-19.0 She swings the lollipop staff — a rainbow shockwave blasts out and knocks several giant capsules spinning away. Camera arcs around the blast with her.
19.0-21.0 Camera holds on her cocky victory pose, ribbons settling.
21.0-23.0 A far worse roar behind her. Camera slowly rotates with her head as she turns — ten times as many capsules forming a rainbow tidal flood filling the frame.
23.0-26.0 Full sprint. Camera runs a fast reverse-track in front of her as she swings the staff mid-run, rainbow bursts popping, hopping across rolling capsules, candy shards and glitter everywhere.
26.0-27.0 A house-sized pink capsule slams in from the side and swallows her whole. Camera follows into brief darkness. CLICK — the capsule splits open.
27.0-28.5 Camera pulls back as she crawls out dizzy, rubbing her head, then freezes.
28.5-30.0 Camera follows her gaze and cranes UP: a giant girl's face is pressed to the glass outside, thrilled with her "limited edition magical girl." She looks at herself, then the capsule shell, then points at her own chest. The giant hand reaches in. She grabs the staff and bolts toward camera. Hard cut mid-run.

[DIALOGUE — Japanese, short, shouted mid-motion, no subtitles]
2.5s, confused: 「えっ、詰まってる？」
5.0s, indignant, tapping the machine: 「ちょっと、返してよ！」
8.0s, screaming: 「待って待って待って——！」
16.0s, annoyed and fired up: 「走るだけだと思った？」
20.0s, smug: 「ふふん、こんなもん？」
22.5s, smile freezing: 「……今の、取り消し。」
29.0s, total disbelief then panic: 「私がガチャ！？いやーっ！」
Young, bright, energetic female voice with real comedic timing. No narration.

[STYLE / TECHNICAL]
Hyper-saturated stylized 3D animation with anime shading and glossy toy-plastic materials, extremely expressive cartoon facial rig, strong squash-and-stretch, anime reaction FX (sweat drops, shock lines, puff-of-dust, sparkle bursts) used comedically. Aesthetic blend: Japanese magical-girl anime, Hi-Fi Rush high-energy rhythmic flow, designer-toy / gachapon collectible world, absurdist comedy timing. Bright pastel candy palette, bloom, glitter and confetti particles, rainbow refraction, lens flares, motion blur, brief speed ramps on staff hits, camera shake on capsule impacts. Handheld-organic single-camera gimbal feel, low and dynamic framing, camera constantly moving. 24fps, 2.39:1 widescreen. Comedic and cute the whole way — never actually scary or dark.

[NEGATIVE]
cuts, edits, jump cuts, transitions, scene changes, montage, freeze frame, fade to black, slow-motion ending, static locked-off camera, blank deadpan face, unchanging expression, character inconsistency, hair color change, eye color change, costume change, staff design change, second weapon, duplicate lookalike girls, dark or horror mood, desaturated grading, gore, blood, injury, crying from real pain, sexualized posing, low-angle upskirt framing, realistic photo style, off-model face, warped hands, extra fingers, subtitles, text artifacts, watermark, logo overlay, blurry, low detail, idle empty frames.

[AUDIO]
Bubbly J-pop chiptune-orchestral hybrid, fast tempo, brass stabs and comedic timpani hits synced to her reactions. Gachapon knob click and hollow rattle at the open, huge mechanical grinding overhead at 7s, thunderous rolling plastic booms, capsule cracks, cartoon whoosh on the slide, sparkling chimes on rainbow blasts, a single comedic record-scratch beat at 21s, then the flood roar swelling. Cute "kacha" click when the capsule opens, dizzy woozy chime, then a giant childlike squeal of delight from outside the glass and a huge orchestral panic sting on the final run. No narration.

2. Gardez un ton naturel et fluide en français — pas une traduction mot à mot.
3. Préservez tout le formatage (retours à la ligne, puces).

---
[CHARACTER LOCK]
Une magical girl, âge ~15 ans, petite silhouette, visage cartoon très expressif.
CHEVEUX : longs cheveux arc-en-ciel volumineux — mèches rose, bleu ciel, jaune et lilas fondues en douces dégradés façon bonbon, longueurs latérales bouclées et duveteuses, frange ondulée avec une pince en forme de cœur rose et une petite épingle étoile, attachés haut avec un nœud ruban arc-en-ciel, quelques mèches toujours en train de rebondir.
VISAGE : grands yeux ronds violet-rose avec reflets en forme de cœur et scintillements étoilés, longs cils, peau pâle, fort blush rose sur les deux joues, bouche très mobile qui s’ouvre grand quand elle crie.
TENUE : bomber court blanc oversize porté ouvert, manches longues, imprimé de pois pastel, cœurs et volutes arc-en-ciel, finitions roses et bleues ; en dessous, crop top rayé rose et blanc avec un grand emblème cœur pastel sur la poitrine et des bretelles arc-en-ciel ; jupe plissée blanche avec bandes roses et bleues à l’ourlet et imprimés de cœurs pastel ; choker rose avec un petit pendentif cœur ; rubans arc-en-ciel et petites breloques étoile pendantes aux hanches ; chaussettes candy rayées dépareillées — anneaux rose/bleu/jaune, l’une plus haute que l’autre, avec revers en forme de cœur ; grosses sneakers blanches à plateforme avec panneaux arc-en-ciel pastel, petites ailes d’ange blanches sur les talons.
SAC À DOS : sac à dos rose et bleu avec fenêtre en forme de cœur et petites ailes d’ange blanches au dos, bretelles arc-en-ciel, petites breloques pendantes.
ARME : bâton magique sucette — long manche blanc entouré d’un enroulement rayé rose façon bonbon, surmonté d’un grand disque sucette rond à spirale arc-en-ciel encadré d’or avec une petite couronne et de petites ailes d’ange blanches, longs rubans flottants roses et bleus. Tire des ondes de choc ARC-EN-CIEL.
PALETTE LOCK : rose vif #FF5C9E, bleu ciel #62CFF4, jaune beurre #FFE07A, lilas #C9A6F5, blanc #FFFFFF.
Même visage, mêmes cheveux arc-en-ciel, même veste, même bâton dans tous les plans. Aucun changement de costume, aucune autre fille ressemblante.

[EXPRESSION TRACK — mandatory, cartoon-level acting, must read on her face]
0-2s anticipation joyeuse et excitée, grand sourire bouche ouverte, rebondissant sur la pointe des pieds, yeux pétillants → 2-4s clignement vide et confus, elle se penche pour plisser les yeux à travers la vitre, tête inclinée → 4-5s moue indignée, joues gonflées, sourcils froncés, tapotant la machine → 5-7s la secousse frappe : l’air suffisant disparaît instantanément, cou raide figé, tête levée d’un coup, yeux immenses → 7-9s panique totale, pupilles réduites à des points, bouche grande ouverte en cri, bras agités tandis qu’elle détale → 9-13s terreur de course frénétique, elle regarde par-dessus son épaule, puis visage horrifié tout blanc, façon « je suis morte » → 13-15s reprise de contrôle maladroite après la glissade, poussiéreuse et décoiffée, sourire tremblant de soulagement → 15-17s l’agacement remplace la peur : sourcils abaissés en froncement déterminé, bouche serrée, elle agrippe fort le bâton → 17-19s visage de combat féroce et confiant, yeux plissés, puis ses yeux s’illuminent de joie devant son propre succès → 19-21s sourire narquois triomphant, poitrine en avant, une main sur la hanche → 21-23s le sourire se fige net, puis se fissure — elle se tourne lentement, horrifiée, goutte de sueur, coin de la bouche qui tressaute → 23-26s désespoir comique à pleine vitesse, larmes coulant de côté, elle crie en courant et en balançant les bras → 26-28s elle ressort hébétée et étourdie, des spirales dans les yeux, se frottant la tête, grimaçant → 28-29s l’expression se fige complètement, mâchoire qui tombe, incrédulité totale, elle se pointe du doigt → 29-30s panique explosive toute neuve, cheveux qui se hérissent, hurlement, elle s’enfuit en sprintant.

ja.content:
---
[CHARACTER LOCK]
魔法少女ひとり、年齢は約15歳、小柄な体型、カートゥーン調に表情豊かな顔。
HAIR: 長くボリュームのあるレインボーヘア — ピンク、スカイブルー、イエロー、ライラックの筋が、やわらかなキャンディグラデーションで溶け合っている。ふわふわにカールしたサイドの長さ、ピンクのハートクリップと小さな星ピンを留めたウェーブ前髪、高い位置でレインボーリボンのボウに結ばれていて、数本の毛束はいつも弾むように跳ねている。
FACE: ハート形のハイライトと星のきらめきが入った、大きく丸いバイオレットピンクの瞳、濃いまつげ、色白の肌、両頬に強いピンクのチーク、叫ぶと大きく開くとても可動域の広い口。
OUTFIT: オーバーサイズの白いクロップドボンバージャケットを前 खुलきで着用、袖は長め、パステルのドット、ハート、レインボーの渦模様プリント、ピンクとブルーのトリム。下にはピンクと白のストライプ柄クロップトップ、胸元に大きなパステルハートのエンブレム、レインボーのサスペンダーストラップ。白いプリーツスカートにピンクとブルーの裾ライン、パステルハートのプリント。小さなハートチャーム付きのピンクのチョーカー。腰にはレインボーリボンのストリーマーと小さな星チャームが下がっている。左右非対称のストライプ柄キャンディソックス — ピンク/ブルー/イエローのリング、片方のほうが高め、ハートのカフ付き。厚底の白いプラットフォームスニーカーにパステルレインボーパネル、かかとには小さな白い天使の翼。
BACKPACK: ピンクとブルーのハート窓付きバックパック、背面に白い天使の翼、レインボーストラップ、小さなチャームがぶら下がっている。
WEAPON: ロリポップ魔法の杖 — ピンクのキャンディーストライプの巻きつけがある長い白いシャフトの先に、金色の縁取りがされた大きな丸いレインボースワールのロリポップディスク、小さな王冠と小さな白い天使の翼、長いピンクとブルーのリボンストリーマー。RAINBOWの衝撃波を放つ。
PALETTE LOCK: ホットピンク #FF5C9E、スカイブルー #62CFF4、バターヨロー #FFE07A、ライラック #C9A6F5、ホワイト #FFFFFF。
全フレームで同じ顔、同じレインボーヘア、同じジャケット、同じ杖。衣装変更なし、そっくりな別の少女もなし。

[EXPRESSION TRACK — mandatory, cartoon-level acting, must read on her face]
0-2s 明るく弾む期待感、口を大きく開けた満面の笑み、つま先で跳ねる、瞳がきらきら輝く → 2-4s 困惑した無表情のまばたき、ガラスを覗き込むように身を乗り出し、首を傾げる → 4-5s ふくれっ面の不満顔、頬を膨らませ、眉をしかめ、マシンを叩く → 5-7s 揺れが来る: 得意げな顔が一瞬で消え、首を固く伸ばして上を見上げ、目が大きく見開く → 7-9s 完全なパニック、瞳孔が点のように縮み、口を大きく開けて悲鳴、走り出しながら腕をばたつかせる → 9-13s 必死の逃走、肩越しに振り返り、その後「もう終わった」みたいな真っ白で絶望した顔 → 13-15s スライド後の立て直し、埃まみれで乱れた姿、ほっとしたふらつく笑み → 15-17s 恐怖が怒りに変わる: 眉が下がって決意のしかめ面、口を引き結び、杖を強く握る → 17-19s 勇ましく自信満々のバトル顔、目を細め、次の瞬間には自分の成功に喜んで目が輝く → 19-21s 生意気な勝ち誇りのニヤリ、胸を張り、片手を腰に当てる → 21-23s ニヤリ顔が固まり、そこからひび割れる — ゆっくりとした戦慄の振り向き、汗のしずく、口元のぴくつき → 23-26s 全速力のコミカルな必死さ、涙が横に流れ、走りながら振り回して叫ぶ → 26-28s ぼんやりしてふらふらしながら這い出る、目がぐるぐる、頭をさすって顔をしかめる → 28-29s 表情が完全に固まり、あごが落ちる、完全な信じられなさ、自分を指さす → 29-30s 爆発的な新規パニック、髪がふわっと広がり、叫びながら逃げ出して全力疾走。

[SINGLE CONTINUOUS TAKE — 30s, ONE UNBROKEN SHOT, no cuts]
カメラは一度も切れず、彼女から離れない。
0.0-2.0 キャンディカラーのショッピングモールの一角から始まり、パステルの店先を抜けてかわいいガチャマシンへカメラが寄っていく。彼女は最後のコインを入れ、両手でノブを強く回す。何も起こらない。
2.0-5.0 カメラは彼女の目線の高さまで低く移動し、彼女がガラス越しに目を細める。すると頬を膨らませ、杖でマシンを小突く。
5.0-7.0 地面が激しく揺れる。カメラは彼女の視線に合わせて上を向き、さらに見上げ続ける — 「壁」が空へ向かって伸びていく。明かされる真実: 彼女は数百メートル級のガチャマシンの内部にいる。はるか上方に半透明のドーム天井。
7.0-9.0 頭上で巨大な機械音。ピンク、ブルー、イエローの巨大カプセルが何千個も上から降り注ぐ。彼女が回転して走り出すのに合わせ、カメラは下へ、そして後方へと急旋回する。
9.0-13.0 カメラは彼女の横、やや後ろを低い位置で高速移動。巨大カプセルが背後で激突し、跳ね、転がり、キャンディの紙吹雪に砕け散る。彼女が振り返る — カプセルの洪水が追いついてくる。
13.0-15.0 家ほどの大きさのカプセルが正面から突進してくる。彼女はスライディングでその下をくぐる。カメラも一緒に落ち、床すれすれを滑走し、その後、彼女が雑に立ち上がるのに合わせて上昇する。
15.0-17.0 2個目のカプセルが迫る。カメラは彼女の正面へ回り込み、彼女が足を踏ん張って向き直る。
17.0-19.0 彼女がロリポップの杖を振る — レインボーの衝撃波が放たれ、いくつもの巨大カプセルを弾き飛

ko.content:
[CHARACTER LOCK]
나이 약 15세의 마법소녀 한 명, 아담한 체형, 만화처럼 표정이 풍부한 얼굴.
HAIR: 길고 풍성한 레인보우 헤어 — 핑크, 스카이 블루, 옐로, 라일락 스트릭이 부드러운 캔디 그라데이션으로 섞여 있고, 폭신하게 말린 옆머리, 웨이브 앞머리에는 핑크 하트 클립과 작은 별 핀이 달려 있으며, 레인보우 리본 보우로 높게 묶여 있고, 몇 가닥은 늘 통통 튀듯 흔들린다.
FACE: 하트 모양 하이라이트와 별 반짝임이 들어간 크고 둥근 바이올렛-핑크 눈, 진한 속눈썹, 창백한 피부, 양 볼의 강한 핑크 블러시, 소리칠 때 크게 벌어지는 매우 유연한 입.
OUTFIT: 오버사이즈 화이트 크롭 봄버 재킷을 열어 입었고 소매는 길며, 파스텔 도트, 하트, 레인보우 소용돌이 프린트와 핑크·블루 트리밍이 들어가 있다; 안에는 가슴에 큰 파스텔 하트 엠블럼이 있는 핑크·화이트 스트라이프 크롭탑과 레인보우 서스펜더 스트랩; 핑크와 블루 밑단 스트라이프와 파스텔 하트 프린트가 들어간 화이트 플리츠 스커트; 작은 하트 참이 달린 핑크 초커; 허리 양옆에 매달린 레인보우 리본 스트리머와 작은 별 참; 핑크/블루/옐로 링이 들어간 서로 다른 스트라이프 캔디 삭스 — 한쪽이 더 높고, 하트 커프가 있음; 파스텔 레인보우 패널이 들어간 두툼한 화이트 플랫폼 스니커즈, 뒤꿈치에는 작은 화이트 천사 날개.
BACKPACK: 등 뒤에 화이트 천사 날개가 달린 핑크·블루 하트 윈도우 백팩, 레인보우 스트랩, 작은 참 장식이 매달려 있음.
WEAPON: 롤리팝 매직 스태프 — 핑크 캔디 스트라이프 래핑이 감긴 긴 화이트 샤프트, 위에는 작은 왕관과 작은 화이트 천사 날개가 달린 금색 프레임의 큰 원형 레인보우 소용돌이 롤리팝 디스크가 얹혀 있고, 길게 늘어진 핑크·블루 리본 스트리머가 달려 있다. RAINBOW 쇼크웨이브를 발사한다.
PALETTE LOCK: hot pink #FF5C9E, sky blue #62CFF4, butter yellow #FFE07A, lilac #C9A6F5, white #FFFFFF.
모든 프레임에서 같은 얼굴, 같은 레인보우 헤어, 같은 재킷, 같은 스태프. 의상 변경 없음, 다른 닮은 여자아이 없음.

[EXPRESSION TRACK — mandatory, cartoon-level acting, must read on her face]
0-2s 밝고 들뜬 기대감, 입 크게 벌린 환한 미소, 발끝으로 폴짝폴짝, 눈이 반짝임 → 2-4s 멍한 혼란의 깜빡임, 유리 안을 보려고 몸을 숙이며 눈을 가늘게 뜸, 고개를 갸웃 → 4-5s 발끈한 삐침, 볼이 부풀고, 미간이 찌푸려지며, 기계를 톡톡 두드림 → 5-7s 흔들림이 닥침: 방금 전의 자신만만한 표정이 즉시 사라지고, 목이 뻣뻣하게 굳은 채 위로 올려다봄, 눈이 엄청 커짐 → 7-9s 순수한 공포, 동공이 점처럼 작아지고, 입을 크게 벌려 비명을 지르며, 팔을 허우적대고 달아남 → 9-13s 미친 듯 달리는 공포, 어깨 너머로 뒤를 흘끗 보다가, 곧바로 “나 진짜 끝났다”는 듯한 새하얗게 질린 공포 얼굴 → 13-15s 미끄러진 뒤의 허둥지둥한 회복, 먼지투성이에 흐트러진 모습, 안도한 채 흔들리는 미소 → 15-17s 두려움 대신 짜증: 눈썹이 내려가 결연한 찡그림이 되고, 입을 굳게 다문 채 스태프를 세게 움켜쥠 → 17-19s 사납고 자신감 넘치는 배틀 페이스, 눈을 가늘게 뜨다가, 자신의 성공에 기뻐 눈빛이 반짝임 → 19-21s 건방진 승리의 비웃음, 가슴을 내밀고 한 손은 허리에 → 21-23s 그 비웃음이 그대로 얼어붙었다가, 금이 가듯 깨짐 — 천천히 공포에 질려 돌아보며, 식은땀 한 방울, 입꼬리가 경련 → 23-26s 전속력 코믹 절박함, 눈물이 옆으로 줄줄 흐르고, 달리면서 휘두르며 소리침 → 26-28s 멍하고 어지러운 채 기어 나옴, 눈에는 소용돌이, 머리를 문지르며 얼굴을 찡그림 → 28-29s 표정이 완전히 얼어붙고, 턱이 떨어지며, 완전한 불신, 자기 자신을 가리킴 → 29-30s 폭발적인 새 공포, 머리카락이 부풀어 오르고, 비명을 지르며 전력질주로 도망감.

[SINGLE CONTINUOUS TAKE — 30s, ONE UNBROKEN SHOT, no cuts]
카메라는 절대 컷하지 않고, 그녀를 절대 벗어나지 않는다.
0.0-2.0 캔디색 쇼핑몰 코너에서 시작, 파스텔 매장들을 지나 카메라가 귀여운 가챠폰 기계 쪽으로 밀려 들어간다. 그녀는 마지막 동전을 넣고 양손으로 손잡이를 세게 돌린다. 아무 일도 일어나지 않는다.
2.0-5.0 카메라는 그녀의 눈높이까지 낮게 미끄러지며 유리 너머를 찡그려 보게 하고, 그녀는 볼을 부풀린 뒤 스태프로 기계를 톡톡 친다.
5.0-7.0 바닥이 격렬하게 흔들린다. 카메라는 그녀의 시선을 따라 위로 기울고 계속 치솟는다 — “벽”이 하늘로 솟아오르고 있다. 반전: 그녀는 수백 미터 높이의 가챠폰 기계 안에 있으며, 반투명 돔 천장이 저 멀리 위에 있다.
7.0-9.0 머리 위에서 거대한 기계음이 울린다. 수천 개의 거대한 핑크, 블루, 옐로 캡슐이 위에서 쏟아져 내려온다. 그녀가 몸을 돌려 달리자 카메라도 급히 아래로, 뒤로 휙 꺾인다.
9.0-13.0 카메라는 바닥 가까이에서 그녀의 옆과 약간 뒤를 빠르게 따라간다. 거대한 캡슐들이 뒤에서 부딪히고 튀고 굴러오며 캔디 컨페티로 산산조각 난다. 그녀가 뒤를 돌아본다 — 캡슐 홍수가 전부 따라붙고 있다.
13.0-15.0 집만 한 캡슐이 정면으로 돌진해 온다. 그녀가 슬라이드 태클로 그 아래를 빠져나가고, 카메라도 함께 바닥으로 낮아져 바닥을 스치듯 지나간 뒤, 그녀가 허둥지둥 일어나며 다시 올라간다.
15.0-17.0 두 번째 캡슐이 다가온다. 카메라는 그녀의 정면으로 돌아가고, 그녀는 발을 딛고 서서 맞선다.
17.0-19.0 그녀가 롤리팝 스태프를 휘두른다 — 레인보우 쇼크웨이브가 터져 나오며 여러 개의 거대한 캡슐을 빙글빙글 날려 보낸다. 카메라도 그녀와 함께 폭발을 따라 원을 그리며 돈다.
19.0-21.0 카메라는 그녀

pt.content:
Você é um tradutor profissional especializado em conteúdo de IA e tecnologia criativa.

Traduza o texto a seguir para o português (Brasil).

Regras:
1. Mantenha todos os termos técnicos com precisão (por exemplo, "prompt", "cinematic", "camera pan" podem permanecer em inglês ou usar traduções consagradas no idioma de destino).
2. Mantenha o tom natural e fluido no idioma de destino — não faça uma tradução palavra por palavra.
3. Preserve qualquer formatação (quebras de linha, marcadores).
4. Se o texto contiver um prompt real do Seedance/IA (instruções de geração), mantenha-o em inglês e traduza apenas o contexto/explicação ao redor.

Texto para traduzir:
---
[CHARACTER LOCK]
Uma garota mágica, idade ~15, porte pequeno, rosto cartunesco e extremamente expressivo.
CABELO: cabelo arco-íris longo e volumoso — mechas rosa, azul-céu, amarelo e lilás misturadas em suaves gradientes de bala, laterais fofas e cacheadas, franja ondulada com um clipe de coração rosa e um pequeno broche de estrela, preso no alto com um laço de fita arco-íris, alguns fios sempre quicando.
ROSTO: olhos grandes, redondos, violeta-rosados, com brilhos em forma de coração e faíscas de estrela, cílios grossos, pele clara, blush rosa forte nas duas bochechas, boca muito móvel que se abre bem quando ela grita.
ROUPA: jaqueta bomber cropped branca oversized usada aberta, mangas longas, estampada com poás pastel, corações e espirais arco-íris, acabamento rosa e azul; por baixo, um top cropped listrado rosa e branco com um grande emblema de coração pastel no peito e alças suspensas arco-íris; saia plissada branca com listras rosa e azul na barra e estampas de corações pastel; choker rosa com um pequeno pingente de coração; fitas de arco-íris e pequenos pingentes de estrela pendurados nos quadris; meias candy listradas e desencontradas — anéis rosa/azul/amarelo, uma mais alta que a outra, com punhos em forma de coração; tênis plataforma brancos robustos com painéis arco-íris pastel, pequenas asas de anjo brancas nos calcanhares.
MOCHILA: mochila rosa e azul com janela em forma de coração e asas de anjo brancas nas costas, alças arco-íris, pequenos pingentes pendurados.
ARMA: cajado mágico de pirulito — haste longa branca com enrolamento em listras de bala rosa, coroado por um grande disco de pirulito em espiral arco-íris, emoldurado em dourado, com uma pequena coroa e pequenas asas de anjo brancas, longas fitas pendentes rosa e azul. Dispara ondas de choque ARCO-ÍRIS.
PALETA FIXA: rosa-choque #FF5C9E, azul-céu #62CFF4, amarelo-manteiga #FFE07A, lilás #C9A6F5, branco #FFFFFF.
Mesmo rosto, mesmo cabelo arco-íris, mesma jaqueta, mesmo cajado em todos os frames. Sem troca de roupa, sem outras garotas parecidas.

[EXPRESSION TRACK — mandatory, cartoon-level acting, must read on her face]
0-2s bright excited anticipation, huge open grin, bouncing on her toes, eyes sparkling → 2-4s confused blank blink, leaning in to squint at the glass, head tilting → 4-5s indignant pout, cheeks puffed, brows scrunched, tapping the machine → 5-7s the shake hits: smug look instantly wipes away, stiff frozen neck-crane upward, eyes going huge → 7-9s pure panic, pupils shrinking to dots, mouth wide open in a scream, arms flailing as she bolts → 9-13s frantic running terror, glancing back over her shoulder, then an "I'm so dead" flat-white horrified face → 13-15s scrappy recovery after the slide, dusty and disheveled, relieved wobbly grin → 15-17s annoyance replaces fear: brows lowering into a determined frown, mouth set, gripping the staff hard → 17-19s fierce confident battle face, eyes narrowed, then eyes lighting up in delight at her own success → 19-21s cocky triumphant smirk, chest out, one hand on hip → 21-23s the smirk freezes solid, then cracks — slow horrified turn, sweat drop, corner of mouth twitching → 23-26s full-speed comedic desperation, tears streaming sideways, shouting while running and swinging → 26-28s dazed and dizzy crawling out, swirls in her eyes, rubbing her head, wincing → 28-29s expression freezes completely, jaw dropping, total disbelief, pointing at herself → 29-30s explosive fresh panic, hair puffing out, screaming, sprinting away.

[SINGLE CONTINUOUS TAKE — 30s, ONE UNBROKEN SHOT, no cuts]
The camera never cuts and never leaves her.
0.0-2.0 Start in a candy-colored mall corner, camera pushing in past pastel storefronts to a cute gachapon machine. She drops in her last coin and cranks the knob hard with both hands. Nothing happens.
2.0-5.0 Camera drifts low to her eye level as she squints through the glass, then puffs her cheeks and taps the machine with her staff.
5.0-7.0 The ground shakes violently. Camera tilts up with her gaze and keeps craning upward — the "walls" are shooting skyward. Reveal: she is INSIDE a several-hundred-meter-tall gachapon machine, translucent dome ceiling far above.
7.0-9.0 Enormous mechanical grinding overhead. Thousands of giant pink, blue and yellow capsules pour down from the top. Camera whips down and back as she spins and runs.
9.0-13.0 Camera glides fast alongside and slightly behind her, low to the floor. Giant capsules crash, bounce and roll behind her, shattering into candy confetti. She looks back — the whole capsule flood is gaining.
13.0-15.0 A house-sized capsule hurtles at her head-on. She slide-tackles under it; camera drops with the slide, skimming the floor, then rises as she scrambles up messily.
15.0-17.0 Second capsule incoming. Camera swings to her front as she plants her feet and turns to face it.
17.0-19.0 She swings the lollipop staff — a rainbow shockwave blasts out and knocks several giant capsules spinning away. Camera arcs around the blast with her.
19.0-21.0 Camera holds on her cocky victory pose, ribbons settling.
21.0-23.0 A far worse roar behind her. Camera slowly rotates with her head as she turns — ten times as many capsules forming a rainbow tidal flood filling the frame.
23.0-26.0 Full sprint. Camera runs a fast reverse-track in front of her as she swings the staff mid-run, rainbow bursts popping, hopping across rolling capsules, candy shards and glitter everywhere.
26.0-27.0 A house-sized pink capsule slams in from the side and swallows her whole. Camera follows into brief darkness. CLICK — the capsule splits open.
